text.offer: Help? Yes, I could use some help. Joline lets her overgrown offspring run around all over the place, and I can't stand seeing them. Cull them and I will give you a key to Cor Noth. Go and kill five red hydras for me.
text.progress: Return to Amerantha once it's done.
text.complete: Finally. Good job getting rid of those reptiles! Here is the key to Cor Noth, as I promised.

steps.brief: Got some of the red ones? Good. I've seen green ones around as well. Go and kill five green hydras for me.
Good. There are some darker ones out there, a little harder to see, but I have caught a few of them in the town before. Go and kill five black hydras for me.
